name: Thai Kitchen Thin Rice Vermicelli Noodles (Mai Fun)
brandOrRestaurant: Thai Kitchen / A Taste of Thai
whyItWorks: Extremely fine threads of white rice flour that rehydrate in hot water within 3 minutes. Zero gluten, less than 1g fiber per serving, and very easy on strictures.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Soak noodles in boiling water for 3 minutes until tender. Drain and add to warm chicken or vegetable broth.
